item.title: An Ohio lawyer denied partnership over gender wins $2 million award upheld after 9-year legal fight
item.description: In a landmark ruling, Pamela Pantages, a lawyer from Ohio, has triumphed in her discrimination lawsuit against her previous employer. The Eighth District Court of Appeals upheld a $2 million jury award, affirming her allegations of being denied partnership due to age and gender bias, as noted in the firm's owner’s comments. This decision corroborates the jury's findings of sex discrimination and contract breaches at The Becker Law Firm. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: South African father-son duo build record-breaking drone reaching 408 mph
item.description: On December 11, 2025, Mike and Luke Bell shattered records by piloting their Peregreen V4 quadcopter to an astonishing average speed of 408.60 mph, making it the fastest battery-powered quadcopter in history. This remarkable achievement resulted from their dedication to innovative design and rigorous testing, employing advanced aerodynamics and cutting-edge 3D printing techniques. It is a monumental step forward in the realm of drone racing. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
